title: Workflow execution
description: One run of a workflow graph, held by the workflow engine and published to a status exchange whose routing key is the status string.

action-execution.description: Id of the execution this workflow stands behind — the row an operator sees. Wire key: action_execution.

status.description: Conductor status. Not enumerated here: the values come from the workflow engine library rather than from a constants module this catalog read.

spec.description: The workflow definition as compiled from the pack's YAML.

graph.description: Task graph derived from the spec.

state.description: Where the conductor currently is inside that graph.

input.description: Input the workflow was started with.

output.description: Output the workflow produced, once it has any.

context.description: Who asked and why, mirroring the execution's own context.

notify.description: Notification settings carried down from the requesting execution.

errors.description: Failures the conductor collected. Declared with the store's dynamic type, so nothing constrains the shape.
